name: Azor
aliases: Last Guardian of the Immortal Sun
description: Azor is a sphinx, a former parun of the Azorius and the creator of the Immortal Sun, which he made by giving up his planeswalker spark.

summary.text: Azor is a sphinx, a former parun of the Azorius and the creator of the Immortal Sun, which he made by giving up his planeswalker spark.

bio.text: Azor planned with his friend Ugin to free the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas by creating the Immortal Sun on Ixalan as a lure, at the cost of his spark.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: He severed his spark on the shores of Torrezon to create the Immortal Sun, while Bolas learned of the plot and of Azor himself.

bio.text: Ugin's signal never came, and Azor was left without a spark and a prisoner.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: He gifted the Immortal Sun to a monastery and then to the Sun Empire, reclaiming it each time, before sealing himself in Orazca and charging the River Heralds to guard it.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The sphinx in the throne room announces himself as Azor and threatens Vraska.
timeline.quote: I am Azor, the Lawbringer,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace shields Vraska's mind from Azor.
timeline.quote: Jace slammed a psychic ward between the sphinx and Vraska.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace declares himself the Living Guildpact and Azor recoils, calling him the fail-safe.
timeline.quote: I am Jace Beleren, the Living Guildpact,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor greets Vraska and Jace from his throne, asking who they have brought to seal.
timeline.quote: If this gorgon is not my prisoner, then who have you brought for me to seal?

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor calls the Immortal Sun the lock of his prison and Vraska realizes it is what traps planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: The lock of my prison, my finest creation.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor binds Vraska with law magic through Jace's ward, but Jace frees her.
timeline.quote: A binding of glowing white runic magic grabbed hold of her torso and shoved her back toward the door behind them.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor boasts of imposing stability on worlds for thousands of years.
timeline.quote: I used hieromancy to give these people the gift of stability

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor admits he left Ravnica when he finished and Jace admits he has not upheld his duties as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Because Ravnica was one of many, and I left when I was finished.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers and that he gave up his spark to make it.
timeline.quote: I gave up my spark to help create the Immortal Sun, the lock of my prison, my greatest gift to all living things.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor explains the failed plan with a friend to lure a foe to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: He was to lure our foe to a faraway plane and I was to use the Immortal Sun to enhance my hieromancy and summon that foe here, to Ixalan.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor explains he gave the Immortal Sun to a monastery in Torrezon and then to others who proved unworthy.
timeline.quote: I initially gifted it to a monastery in the east, in Torrezon.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor attacks Vraska and Jace; Vraska cuts his leg.
timeline.quote: Vraska unsheathed her sword and cut a long thin line across Azor's back leg.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace attacks Azor's mind with a migraine.
timeline.quote: manipulate Azor's mind, sending the feeling of a piercing migraine through the sphinx's head.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska accuses Azor of causing centuries of war and her own suffering.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun has spawned hundreds of years of conflict on this plane,

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace takes responsibility to judge Azor as Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: It is my responsibility to act on behalf of Ravnica.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the plan was to imprison Nicol Bolas, and Jace remembers him.
timeline.quote: Our intention was to imprison Nicol Bolas

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace sentences Azor to be the caretaker of Useless Island, never to leave or meddle again.
timeline.quote: You will be the master and caretaker of Useless Island.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor flies away, leaving the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: He beat them, rose into the air, and flew out the door Vraska and Jace had entered through without another word.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin arrives on Azor's newest plane, welcomed by crowds, to meet his associate.
timeline.quote: His name was Ugin, and his purpose was, and always had been, singular.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Azor he has a plan to free the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Together we will rid the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor outlines creating the Immortal Sun on Ixalan to summon Bolas, at the cost of his spark.
timeline.quote: I will build the Immortal Sun there, on the continent of Torrezon.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin says he will lure Bolas to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas interrogates an elf bureaucrat about the lawbringer and learns of Azor.
timeline.quote: The sphinx was called Azor.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: On another plane Bolas absorbs a lawmage's mind, learning of the plot and killing her.
timeline.quote: listening to him and the Spirit Dragon plot the end of the True Evil

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor severs his spark on the shores of Torrezon to create the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: severing his spark to create the artifact he called the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas mocks Azor's statues as the reason he was found.
timeline.quote: Your idiot cat is too fond of statues of himself,

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor waits in vain for Ugin's signal, left without a spark and a prisoner.
timeline.quote: Azor was left without a spark, and his prison without a prisoner.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor gifts the Immortal Sun to a monastery and then to the Sun Empire, reclaiming it each time.
timeline.quote: He gifted the Immortal Sun to a monastery that would later give rise to the Legion of Dusk

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor seals himself in Orazca and charges the River Heralds to guard it.
timeline.quote: this time sealing himself within the walls of Orazca and charging the River Heralds

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor and Ugin meet at the Palace of Justice and devise a plan to get rid of Bolas.
timeline.quote: Together, they devised a plan to get rid of Bolas for good.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor travels to Ixalan and sacrifices his spark to create the Immortal Sun, trapping himself there too.
timeline.quote: By this act, he also trapped himself on the plane.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reach Azor in his sanctum in Orazca; he reveals he never received Ugin's signal.
timeline.quote: but that he had never received Ugin's signal to activate the sun and draw the evil dragon to the plane.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace stops Vraska from killing Azor and, as the Living Guildpact, sentences him to solitude on Useless Island.
timeline.quote: but Jace stopped her.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor fights alongside Elenda of Garrano defending Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Azor fought alongside Elenda of Garrano in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda fights alongside Azor in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Elenda fought alongside Azor in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ixalan, Jace used the Guildpact to force Azor to spend the rest of his life in solitude.
timeline.quote: Even on Ixalan , Jace could force Azor to spend the rest of his life in solitude

citation.text: "Guildpact (spell)", section "Areas of influence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his spark, trapping himself and preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Azor created the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his planeswalker's spark

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hostile forces under Pedron the Wicked attack the monastery in Torrezon; Azor takes the Sun across the sea to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: The Sun was taken by Azor, and he brought it across the sea to the continent of Ixalan

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire builds Orazca around the Immortal Sun until an emperor misuses it, and Azor makes the Empire leave the hidden city.
timeline.quote: As a consequence, Azor caused the Empire to leave the city.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor tasks the merfolk River Heralds with defending the Golden City and the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The merfolk River Heralds were then tasked by Azor to defend the Golden City

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "River Heralds". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun in 3279 AR to trap Nicol Bolas, preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Azor created a powerful artifact known as the Immortal Sun to trap Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pedron the Wicked steals the Immortal Sun from its monastery but Azor reclaims it.
timeline.quote: stole the Immortal Sun but lost it to Azor, who reclaimed it

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace sentences Azor to be caretaker of Useless Island.
timeline.quote: he sentenced Azor to be the caretaker of Useless Island

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is placed in Alta Torrezon's care by Azor, then stolen by Pedron the Wicked who loses it to Azor.
timeline.quote: The monastery fell under attack by the forces of the rival king Pedron the Wicked who stole the Immortal Sun but in turn, lost it to Azor.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas learns of Azor and Ugin's plan to imprison him.
timeline.quote: Bolas discovered the plan thanks to Azor leaving hints of himself on the planes that he had ordered.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Defeating Ugin again". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace meet Azor, who reveals Ixalan was meant to be Bolas's prison; they plan to infiltrate Bolas's organization.
timeline.quote: Vraska and Jace hatched a plan to infiltrate Bolas' organization

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ten factions sign the Guildpact to end Ravnica's centuries of war, becoming the ten guilds.
timeline.quote: Each of the ten factions signed the Guildpact

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Government and law: Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Izzet discover Azor I's contingency plan; the power of a new Guildpact is bestowed on Jace, who becomes the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: That power was eventually bestowed upon Jace Beleren

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "The Guildpact reinstated". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor leaves Ravnica after founding the Azorius to bring order to other planes.
timeline.quote: he left Ravnica after some time to bring order and guidance to other planes of the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Sphinx", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As parun, Svogthir signs the Guildpact third, after Azor and Razia, and helps convince the forces of chaos to sign.
timeline.quote: Svogthir was instrumental in convincing the forces of chaos to become signatories of the pact.

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Rise and fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace defeats Azor and becomes romantically involved with Vraska.
timeline.quote: Jace defeats Azor and becomes romantically involved with Vraska .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace uses the Living Guildpact to banish the sphinx Azor to Useless Island.
timeline.quote: Vraska witnessed how Jace used his power as the Living Guildpact to banish the Sphinx to Useless Island

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
